description: We are SOLVIX, a team from Egypt united by our passion for space, technology, and creativity.For NASA Space Apps, we created Harly’s NASA Quest, an interactive adventure that transforms real NASA data into an exciting journey, where users explore spacecraft, discover their stories, and become part of the adventure.We believe space exploration isn't just information — it's an experience! 🚀
summary:
"Hi, Moons!" Welcome to Harly’s NASA Quest, an interactive space journey powered by real NASA data, where cosmic machines finally tell their own stories. We didn’t just build an informational website—we built a living universe where rovers and spacecraft across the Moon, Mars, and beyond introduce themselves. Guided by Harly, your astronaut companion who voices each machine’s story, you’ll explore space technology through captivating first-person storytelling.

But it doesn’t stop at listening—now, you become the machine. Dive into a two-level game: in the Easy Level, you play as the featured spacecraft; in the Hard Level, you either choose one of those machines or engineer your own custom device from existing parts, with Harly silently by your side. This is NASA data like you’ve never seen it before—not in charts or reports, but in the palm of your hand as a playful, high-stakes adventure.
details:
Solvix is an interactive, web-based space exploration platform designed to introduce users to space devices and missions through storytelling, exploration, and gaming. Using real NASA data, the platf

orm transforms space knowledge into an engaging and enjoyable learning experience.

How It Works:

1. Interactive Space Device Stories

Solvix features 9 different space devices, each telling its own story from its own perspective. Through fun and interactive storytelling, every device introduces itself, explains its mission, and shares its journey and experiences in space, helping users understand its purpose and role in space exploration.

2. Harly’s NASA Quest – Interactive Game

At the end of the learning journey, users join Harly in a two-level space adventure:

  • Level 1 – Device Assembly: A beginner-friendly level where users learn how to assemble a space device by putting its parts together.
  • Level 2 – Build Your Own Space Device: A more advanced, multi-step challenge where users create their own complete space device by assembling its components, choosing its name, and selecting its destination, such as the Moon or Mars. Once the device is ready, users begin an exploration mission to discover the destination they selected.
  • Key Benefits & Impact
  • Makes learning about space devices more engaging through interactive storytelling.
  • Introduces users to real space missions and technologies using NASA data.
  • Combines education, creativity, and gaming in one experience.
  • Encourages problem-solving, exploration, and creative thinking.
  • Allows users to build their own space devices and experience a simulated space exploration journey.
